purpose: AI-generated illustrative editorial photographs; not customer portraits or testimonials.

prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: a photographic card for TypingEase, a minimal premium typing-learning website. Create a single natural, believable editorial photograph, landscape 4:3 framing. Person framed waist-up, face and keyboard both clearly visible, comfortable typing posture. Warm soft daylight, realistic skin texture, subtle film grain, gentle shallow depth of field, subdued neutral cream and sage-green palette. Candid and quietly happy, not posed stock-photo grin. No text, letters overlaid, watermarks, logos, UI, borders, montage or illustration. Keep face in upper middle and keyboard in bottom third, suitable for a centered crop. Subject: Vietnamese woman in her mid twenties with a short dark bob, cream cotton shirt, sitting at a bright oak desk by a large apartment window, gently smiling while concentrating on typing on a slim silver laptop. A softly blurred green plant in background. Camera slightly above laptop height, three-quarter front view. Natural anatomically correct hands resting on keyboard.
